title: SAP Analytics Cloud Failures by Story
app: SAP Analytics Cloud audit and activity exports via the SAC API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=sac:audit status="Failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by story_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts SAP Analytics Cloud failures grouped by story so operators immediately see which specific storys are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'SAP Analytics Cloud is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest SAP Analytics Cloud failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical storys.
visualization: Table of story by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of SAP Analytics Cloud are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
